name: riscv
notes: The middle vertex of the C / RISC-V / BTOR2 triangle: RV64IM assembly text with a frame discipline — `fence` is the frame boundary, `ebreak` the bad location, `ecall` a7=93 the absorbing halt, `ecall` a7=1 an input read at havoc site a1 (a0 takes steps[t][str(a1)], missing 0) — so bad and depth align frame-for-frame with the c machine (one CFG node per frame) and the btor2 machine (one transition per frame), and every pair around the triangle keeps both observables exactly under the identity map. Stimulus {"steps": [{"<site>": value, ...}, ...]}. Byte-addressed little-endian memory, .data at 0x10000, 32 64-bit registers, sp = 0x7ffffff0, entry at _start / main / first instruction. A frame of 10^6 instructions without a fence is refused, never guessed at. No domain of its own: corroborated only by its pairs' squares — the pincer.
